doc:
# Firewalls — Black Hole Information

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “firewall black hole”).

claims.name: firewall_argument_prescribes_discarding_equivalence
claims.statement: The firewall argument prescribes discarding the equivalence principle in favor of an energy barrier (or firewall) at the black hole horizon.

sources.title: Black holes and information: A new take on an old paradox

claims.name: nofirewall_black_hole_setup_assumed
claims.statement: A no-firewall black hole setup is assumed for information-retrieval discussion.

sources.title: How to Recover a Qubit That Has Fallen Into a Black Hole

claims.name: old_black_hole_tunnel_into
claims.statement: An old black hole can tunnel into a white hole/firewall by emitting large baby universes.

sources.title: Firewalls from wormholes in higher genus

claims.name: firewall_puzzle_shows_much_remains
claims.statement: The firewall puzzle shows much remains unclear about black hole information and complementarity.

claims.name: results_have_interesting_relationship_discussions
claims.statement: The results have an interesting relationship with discussions of the black hole firewall problem.

sources.title: Quantum entanglement in de Sitter space with a wall, and the decoherence of bubble universes

claims.name: black_hole_firewall_problem_motivates
claims.statement: The black hole firewall problem motivates the study of entangled wavepackets in the vacuum.

claims.name: black_hole_complementarity_does_not
claims.statement: Black hole complementarity does not by itself imply a firewall for infalling observers at the horizon.

claims.name: black_hole_soft_hair_hps
claims.statement: Black hole soft hair in the HPS framework is central to resolving the AMPS firewall tension.

sources.title: HPS meets AMPS: How Soft Hair Dissolves the Firewall

claims.name: loop_effects_alter_geometry_boundary
claims.statement: Loop effects alter the geometry and boundary conditions in black hole spacetimes under the Firewall proposal.

sources.title: On Firewalls in quantum-corrected General Relativity

claims.name: results_have_implications_black_hole
claims.statement: The results have implications for black hole complementarity, the quantum equivalence principle, and the firewall phenomenon.

sources.title: On the observer dependence of the Hilbert space near the horizon of black holes

claims.name: modern_versions_hawkings_black_hole
claims.statement: Modern versions of Hawking's black hole information paradox lead to exotic alternatives to classical black hole horizons such as the fuzzball and firewall paradigms.

sources.title: Echoes from the Abyss: Tentative evidence for Planck-scale structure at black hole horizons

claims.name: show_very_old_black_hole
claims.statement: We show that a very old black hole can tunnel to a white hole/firewall by emitting a large baby universe.

claims.name: decoupling_early_late_radiation_mechanism
claims.statement: Decoupling early and late radiation is a mechanism used to avoid the firewall in black hole evaporation.

sources.title: Evaporating black holes and late-stage loss of soft hair

claims.name: alternative_firewall_experiment_performed_within
claims.statement: An alternative firewall experiment can be performed within a black hole's lifetime by precomputing the unscrambling of information on a quantum memory before black hole formation.

sources.title: Firewalls and flat mirrors: An alternative to the AMPS experiment which evades the Harlow-Hayden obstacle

claims.name: whether_bobs_black_hole_has
claims.statement: Whether Bob's black hole has a firewall depends on what Alice does with the entangled partner system.

sources.title: Cool horizons for entangled black holes

claims.name: correlations_between_hawking_partner_particles
claims.statement: The correlations between the Hawking and partner particles imply that the analogue black hole has no analogue firewall.

sources.title: Observation of thermal Hawking radiation at the Hawking temperature in an analogue black hole

claims.name: framework_allows_quantitative_study_transition
claims.statement: The framework allows quantitative study of the transition into the firewall regime of maximally mixed black hole states

sources.title: Black Hole Entanglement and Quantum Error Correction

claims.name: black_hole_claimed_amps_shielded
claims.statement: The black hole is claimed by AMPS to be shielded by a firewall no later than Page time.
